name: stepfunctions
description: Step Functions With Step Functions, you can create workflows, also called state machines, to build distributed applications, automate processes, orchestrate microservices, and create data and machine learning pipelines.

subcommands.name: create-activity
subcommands.description: Creates an activity.

subcommands.name: create-state-machine
subcommands.description: Creates a state machine.

subcommands.name: create-state-machine-alias
subcommands.description: Creates an alias for a state machine that points to one or two versions of the same state machine.

subcommands.name: delete-activity
subcommands.description: Deletes an activity.

subcommands.name: delete-state-machine
subcommands.description: Deletes a state machine.

subcommands.name: delete-state-machine-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes a state machine alias.

subcommands.name: delete-state-machine-version
subcommands.description: Deletes a state machine version.

subcommands.name: describe-activity
subcommands.description: Describes an activity.

subcommands.name: describe-execution
subcommands.description: Provides information about a state machine execution, such as the state machine associated with the execution, the execution input and output, and relevant execution metadata.

subcommands.name: describe-map-run
subcommands.description: Provides information about a Map Run's configuration, progress, and results.

subcommands.name: describe-state-machine
subcommands.description: Provides information about a state machine's definition, its IAM role Amazon Resource Name (ARN), and configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-state-machine-alias
subcommands.description: Returns details about a state machine alias.

subcommands.name: describe-state-machine-for-execution
subcommands.description: Provides information about a state machine's definition, its execution role ARN, and configuration.

subcommands.name: get-activity-task
subcommands.description: Used by workers to retrieve a task (with the specified activity ARN) which has been scheduled for execution by a running state machine.

subcommands.name: get-execution-history
subcommands.description: Returns the history of the specified execution as a list of events.

subcommands.name: list-activities
subcommands.description: Lists the existing activities.

subcommands.name: list-executions
subcommands.description: Lists all executions of a state machine or a Map Run.

subcommands.name: list-map-runs
subcommands.description: Lists all Map Runs that were started by a given state machine execution.

subcommands.name: list-state-machine-aliases
subcommands.description: Lists aliases for a specified state machine ARN.

subcommands.name: list-state-machine-versions
subcommands.description: Lists versions for the specified state machine Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: list-state-machines
subcommands.description: Lists the existing state machines.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List tags for a given resource.

subcommands.name: publish-state-machine-version
subcommands.description: Creates a version from the current revision of a state machine.

subcommands.name: redrive-execution
subcommands.description: Restarts unsuccessful executions of Standard workflows that didn't complete successfully in the last 14 days.

subcommands.name: send-task-failure
subcommands.description: Used by activity workers, Task states using the callback pattern, and optionally Task states using the job run pattern to report that the task identified by the taskToken failed.

subcommands.name: send-task-heartbeat
subcommands.description: Used by activity workers and Task states using the callback pattern, and optionally Task states using the job run pattern to report to Step Functions that the task represented by the specified taskToken is still making progress.

subcommands.name: send-task-success
subcommands.description: Used by activity workers, Task states using the callback pattern, and optionally Task states using the job run pattern to report that the task identified by the taskToken completed successfully.

subcommands.name: start-execution
subcommands.description: Starts a state machine execution.

subcommands.name: start-sync-execution
subcommands.description: Starts a Synchronous Express state machine execution.

subcommands.name: stop-execution
subcommands.description: Stops an execution.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add a tag to a Step Functions resource.

subcommands.name: test-state
subcommands.description: Accepts the definition of a single state and executes it.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove a tag from a Step Functions resource

subcommands.name: update-map-run
subcommands.description: Updates an in-progress Map Run's configuration to include changes to the settings that control maximum concurrency and Map Run failure.

subcommands.name: update-state-machine
subcommands.description: Updates an existing state machine by modifying its definition, roleArn, loggingConfiguration, or EncryptionConfiguration.

subcommands.name: update-state-machine-alias
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of an existing state machine alias by modifying its description or routingConfiguration.

subcommands.name: validate-state-machine-definition
subcommands.description: Validates the syntax of a state machine definition specified in Amazon States Language (ASL), a JSON-based, structured language.
